import sys

args = sys.argv[1:]
num = "-n" in args
names = [a for a in args if a != "-n"]
out = []
status = 0
n = 0


def emit(text):
    global n
    if not num:
        out.append(text)
        return
    parts = text.split("\n")
    lines = [p + "\n" for p in parts[:-1]]
    if parts[-1]:
        lines.append(parts[-1])
    for line in lines:
        n += 1
        if not line.endswith("\n"):
            line += "\n"
        out.append("%6d\t%s" % (n, line))


if not names:
    emit(sys.stdin.buffer.read().decode("latin-1"))
else:
    for name in names:
        try:
            with open(name, "rb") as f:
                data = f.read().decode("latin-1")
        except OSError:
            out.append("cat: %s: No such file\n" % name)
            status = 1
            continue
        emit(data)

sys.stdout.buffer.write("".join(out).encode("latin-1"))
sys.stdout.flush()
sys.exit(status)
